name: Dystopia ~Bougyaku no Mirai~
original_name: デストピア ~暴虐の未来~
source: Seiji is a teacher at the West Star Academy with a secret agenda - to take revenge on a female teacher Ruriko for some slight she did to him. Natheless, revenge is dish best served cold, and Seiji first intends to corrupt and turn into the sex slaves three of Ruriko's favorite students Sae, Chisato and Manami using drugs and hypnosis. To that end he gets the help of a yakuza boss Ryouji and another student Yuriko.
translation: 清司是西星學園的教師，卻懷有一個秘密目的：向曾冒犯自己的女教師三塚瑠璃子復仇。不過，復仇這道菜，冷著吃最美味；清司打算先用藥物和催眠腐化瑠璃子最喜歡的三名學生——西方紗枝、長柄千里與小池愛美——將她們變成性奴。為此，他得到黑幫頭目良二和另一名學生百合香的幫助。
